title: Board time and a daily on/off schedule
summary: Read and set boot-local board time over every existing transport, schedule LEDs On at 18:00 and Off at 06:00 by default, and bypass scheduling while time is invalid. APK auto-sync is enabled by default and runs on the next connection at least 15 minutes after the last confirmed sync; follow the phone's time zone and DST. Manual On/Off always overrides until explicitly returned to scheduling. Planning only; owner product questions are resolved and the seed is ready for S2S.
